text:
alexa: quick heads-up9 - after the retry middleware roll a handful of staging webhooks are duplicated. small percent ~0.7% but reproducible.
ci-bot: deploy: go-sdk@1.13.0 rolled to staging (2026-06-12T03:02:10Z) :rocket:
samir: ugh. can you paste a sanitized trace? important: is Retry-After numeric or an HTTP-date?
alexa: sanitized snippet: 
```
POST /hooks/payment -> 429
Response headers: Retry-After: Tue, 12 Jun 2026 03:05:00 GMT
client retry immediately -> 200 (duplicate delivered)
```
keiko: looks like parity issue: some SDKs parse retry-after only as int and fall back to immediate retry on parse error. also saw jitter funcs that return signed values in a couple of langs. both together explain duplicates.
dan: action plan: 1) SDKs must parse Retry-After as delta-seconds or HTTP-date (RFC7231) - fallback precedence: int -> IMF-fixdate -> rfc850/asctime. 2) If parsed date <= now, treat as min_wait = 1s (avoid immediate retry on skew). 3) Make jitter strictly non-negative and additive (wait += U(0,jitter_ms)). 4) SDK helper and samples should attach X-Redwood-Idempotency (uuid4) by default; explicit opt-out only. 5) CI lint for samples: fail if webhook sender doesn't attach idempotency or opt-out. 6) Emit metric webhook_duplicate_count and dashboard.
samir: good. also add feature flags honor_retry_after (default true) and attach_idempotency (default true) for fast rollback. need unit tests covering numeric/date/expired-date and an e2e that simulates both header formats.
keiko: i'll open a small go patch to parse both formats and add tests (numeric, IMF-fixdate, rfc850, expired-date). will clamp wait and fix jitter.
dan: i'll add the CI lint and samples e2e harness. alexa: can you handle release notes and migration blurb for self-hosted SDK users?
alexa: yep. action items: keiko -> go-sdk PR + tests, dan -> CI lint + samples job, samir -> telemetry + feature flags, alexa -> release notes. ETA: PRs today, staging smoke tomorrow. :thumbsup:
